plan.direction: Quarter-hour candle-turn long-only windows under two capital scales; hold-duration and phase-shift sensitivity.
plan.economic_hypothesis: The published turn-of-candle effect may extend beyond the first minute and may be sensitive to starting capital because the cited study relies on a Bitfinex volume-based fee tier. This test varies hold duration and capital while phase-shift controls test calendar specificity under fixed Binance costs.

primary_source.citation: Shanaev et al. (2023), Turn-of-the-candle effect in bitcoin returns, Heliyon 9:e14236, DOI 10.1016/j.heliyon.2023.e14236
primary_source.limitations: Paper reports 0.58bps/minute average on exact turn minutes and Bitfinex-specific tiered fees; our BTC/ETH Binance sample and $5k/$10k accounts use fixed repository fees and do not assume zero-fee qualification.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 continuous 30-day folds, no fitted parameters, continuous cash across windows
time_boundaries.reuse_note: Repeated repository development/validation period; not an untouched final holdout.

plan.rule: At each UTC hour minute {0,15,30,45} plus fixed phase p, buy at that minute open and sell at open exactly n minutes later (n∈{1,2,3}); phase p∈{0,1,2}. Event schedule is fixed before observations, with 60-second scheduling notice. Event windows do not overlap. Phase0 is primary and phase1/2 are placebo controls.

costs.impact: 0.5 * previous 20 complete UTC daily return standard deviation * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.exchange_filters: Binance PRICE_FILTER, LOT_SIZE, NOTIONAL; adverse tick, lot floor, 5-minute VWAP proxy.

gates.phase_specificity: For each asset × capital × hold duration, exact phase0 average 1x return must exceed phase1 and phase2 averages.

parallel_reservation_conflict.action: No backtest run and no finish attempted for those 20 already-reserved definitions. Their rows and the original folder are preserved; this round uses non-overlapping capital/hold variants.

plan.initial16_audit: research/experiments/20261012T035429Z/prior_evidence_audit.json confirms actual evidence for all 16; none needs a missing-result retry.
